name: alf UMi / Polaris
representative_v_rule: ordinary V range about 1.86-2.13; comfortably inside V<=2.50
evidence: GCVS V-system range and SIMBAD classical Cepheid identity support inclusion; earlier mismatch was catalog reconciliation, not brightness

name: eps UMa / Alioth
evidence: independent bright-star photometry confirms a first-magnitude star; reconciliation miss is an identity-matching issue

name: gam 2 Vel / Gamma Velorum
evidence: SIMBAD lists V=1.83 for the Gamma Velorum system

name: omi Cet / Mira
representative_v_rule: representative ordinary maximum about V3.5; rare maxima can reach or slightly cross V2.5
evidence: AAVSO describes Mira as generally varying around 3.5-9 and records post-1906 maxima spanning about 2.4-4.9; rare bright maxima should be preserved as exceptional-brightness notes, not define membership

name: eta Car / Eta Carinae
representative_v_rule: modern representative V is far fainter than 2.5; historical naked-eye brilliance is exceptional
evidence: SIMBAD lists V about 6.48; historical very bright states belong under outbursts/exceptional brightness rather than ordinary threshold membership

name: V862 Sco
representative_v_rule: modern ordinary brightness about V6.6-6.8, far fainter than 2.5
evidence: the GCVS 2.0 candidate is inconsistent with modern identification/photometry; treat as catalog anomaly pending any contrary primary evidence
